description: This file defines a React functional component called Navbar which renders the top navigation bar for a web application. It includes links, a theme toggle, and authentication-related actions such as login, logout, profile, and register. The component uses React Router hooks for navigation and location, and consumes authentication context for current user info and logout functionality.
